sources.population: 339 studies of similarity and outcomes in established romantic couples
sources.generalAbstractFinding: Similarity association overall mixed across domains; perceived similarity may matter more than actual similarity
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not claim no association everywhere or numeric A05 pair compatibility
sources.limitations: Romantic couples; diverse outcomes and operational definitions; scoping review has no single pooled effect

sources.population: German family panel n=3674 heterosexual couples, 2820 wave 2
sources.generalAbstractFinding: Some similarity measures linked with small positive relationship-satisfaction associations; individual traits generally stronger predictors
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not generalize all types of similarity positively, infer causality, or extrapolate to arbitrary pairs
sources.limitations: Observational heterosexual German couple sample; dimensions and effect estimates require full-text review

sources.generalAbstractFinding: Trait/facet personality similarity was not robustly associated with relationship or life satisfaction in studied models
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not say all kinds of value similarity have zero influence; no A05 constructs tested
sources.limitations: Personality similarity is not identical to values or our editorial axes

sources.generalAbstractFinding: Relationship-specific self-reports predicted current relationship quality; changes were largely unpredictable with studied variables
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not transfer explained-variance numbers into a specific 16-type compatibility forecast
sources.limitations: Machine-learning associations, specific outcomes/sample types, not causal and not A05 pair validation

sources.generalAbstractFinding: Schwartz refined values theory considers 19 motivational values organized in a circular continuum
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not declare A05 A-axis or any of the 16 types validated from Schwartz
sources.limitations: Distinct value system and items; possible conceptual comparison only

sources.population: Conceptual and analytical discussion of dichotomizing quantitative variables
sources.generalAbstractFinding: Arbitrary dichotomization can lose information and distort relationships
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not assert that dichotomization always makes every type model invalid
sources.limitations: General methodological critique; no A05 empirical evaluation

sources.population: SDT motivation and psychological needs framework
sources.generalAbstractFinding: Autonomy, relatedness, competence are distinguished needs rather than the two poles of one preference
sources.prohibitedInference: Do not treat A05 B2-P preference weights as an already validated SDT need-satisfaction scale
sources.limitations: SDT framework and A05 decision-preference domains differ

jointEvidenceFindings.claim: Similarity effects are mixed across romantic relationship studies
jointEvidenceFindings.caution: Positive associations on some dimensions and no robust association in other datasets coexist; measurement/context heterogeneity. No A05 score inference.

jointEvidenceFindings.claim: Individual and relationship-specific variables matter beyond simplified type similarity
jointEvidenceFindings.caution: Do not infer individual A05 pair probability from the predictor comparisons.

jointEvidenceFindings.claim: A/C/D/B2 item design needs construct and content validity review before type assignment
jointEvidenceFindings.caution: These theories neither validate nor automatically reject A05 classification.

methodsSources.scope: Relevance, comprehensiveness, comprehensibility of measurement content, adapted as methodological review
